description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/advection_2d_y_dirichlet_central.esm (model Advection2DyDirichlet, test mms_y_dirichlet_decay) at the problem's default resolution (NY=64, NX edge-bound to 8) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Exercises the second-order centered fixed-value (Dirichlet) first-derivative rule central_D1y_dirichlet_bc (mirror-ghost y-face rows, nonzero walls gB=1, gT=e^2) as the advective y-term of a well-posed advection-diffusion decay problem on the full 2-D field. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

rust._doc: Deterministic Erk-vs-Tsit5 integrator-method disagreement on a floor-sensitive time-integrated functional: mms_y_dirichlet_decay[2] rel 5.05e-08 / abs 1.83e-12 (ref 3.617155e-05). MEASURED from CI run 33272496703 (2026-08-29); the values are bit-stable across runs and the inline assertions pass at the problem-file tolerances, so only the cross-binding re-evaluation band is widened (10x headroom, decade-rounded). Re-tighten if the bindings ever pin the same integrator.
